names.name: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band

summary: Eighth album by the Beatles, made in the studio after they stopped touring, with orchestras, Indian instruments and tape effects. Its elaborate cover and linked songs made the album an art form of its own in rock.
